summary: Frontend-only regression test on the reported bug: 'Unable to resolve module ../../context/AuthContext from /app/frontend/app/activity-log.js'. Verified via source-code inspection AND live browser: activity-log.js line 11 now uses '../context/AuthContext' (correct), Metro bundles successfully with 0 resolve errors, the /activity-log route renders end-to-end. Also cross-checked ALL other files under /app/frontend/app/ that import AuthContext — all use the correct relative depth (root-level app files → '../context/AuthContext', (tabs)/* files → '../../context/AuthContext', platform/* files → '../../context/PlatformAuthContext'). Login flow with association DELETE-TEST + admin@delete-test.local / admin123 works; after login the /activity-log page loads and shows real audit rows (Année activée 2027, Année créée 2027, Membre créé Test ActivityLog). When accessed without auth, the same page correctly renders the role-guard message 'Accès réservé aux administrateurs' with the header 'Journal d'activité'. Bug is RESOLVED.

issues: Repeated console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up before RN 0.75+/Web build to avoid noise and future deprecation removal.

action_items: No action required for the reported bug — it is fixed and verified end-to-end.
OPTIONAL: Address deprecated React Native Web style props (shadow*, pointerEvents) shown in console warnings to reduce log noise.
critical_code_review_comments: Positive: activity-log.js correctly enforces role check `user?.role !== 'ADMIN'` before rendering log content — good defensive UX; server-side /api/activity-log also enforces auth (401 seen for unauth requests).
Positive: All 13 AuthContext / PlatformAuthContext imports across /app/frontend/app/** were audited and are consistent with directory depth. No latent path bugs remain.

Minor: Prior expo.err.log still contains historical 'Unable to resolve module ../../context/AuthContext' entries from BEFORE the fix. These are stale — current bundles compile cleanly (last N `Web Bundled` lines all succeed and browser page has no bundling error banner).
Minor: activity-log.js catches load errors silently with only console.error — consider surfacing a user-visible error state (retry button) instead of showing empty list on API failure.
Minor: The role guard uses a plain string 'ADMIN'; consider centralising role constants to avoid typos across the codebase.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Import path in /app/frontend/app/activity-log.js is now '../context/AuthContext' (correct relative depth since activity-log.js sits at /app/frontend/app/ and AuthContext lives at /app/frontend/context/AuthContext.js). All other AuthContext imports in the codebase were also audited and are correct. If a similar 'Unable to resolve module' bug is reported again, run: `grep -rn AuthContext /app/frontend/app/ /app/frontend/components/` and verify the relative depth matches the file's directory. Do NOT trust supervisor's expo.err.log alone — it accumulates stale errors from previous broken states; always confirm by reloading the app in the browser.
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: activity-log.js was originally created (or moved) with an import path assuming it lived inside a nested folder like /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/, hence '../../context/AuthContext'. But the file actually resides at /app/frontend/app/activity-log.js (root of the app router), so it needs to go up only ONE level to reach /app/frontend/context/AuthContext.js — the correct path is '../context/AuthContext'. FIX APPLIED (already by main agent): line 11 changed from '../../context/AuthContext' to '../context/AuthContext'. VERIFICATION: (1) File source now shows '../context/AuthContext' at line 11 ✓ (2) Metro bundles without error, latest expo.out.log lines end with 'Web Bundled 1307ms' ✓ (3) Browser loads https://mobile-bug-crush-1.preview.emergentagent.com/activity-log and renders the page (header 'Journal d'activité' + role message) with 0 console bundle errors ✓ (4) After login as admin@delete-test.local, the page displays 3 real activity log rows fetched from /api/activity-log ✓.
